title: Quarterly scenario-driven plan for hosted endpoints & model lineup
creator: Aisha Karim
description: This ticket captures a scenario-driven quarterly plan that aligns the hosted endpoints rollout with the model lineup cadence. Focus is on defining staged deliverables, measurable acceptance gates, and cross-team responsibilities so we can confidentally commit to canary schedules and customer communications. The plan emphasizes three usage scenarios: bursty PLG traffic, steady enterprise throughput, and latency-sensitive assistant flows. For each scenario we specify target SLAs, model variant fallbacks, and cost tradeoffs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Mapped milestones for all scenarios with owners and dates. 2) Runbook and canary checklist published for Hosted API model rotations. 3) Performance guardrails defined (latency P95, cost per 1k tokens, error budget) and validated on staging. 4) Cross-team dependency list with committed deliverables. 5) Customer communication templates and deprecation windows drafted.
milestones: Milestone 1: Scenario definitions & priority matrix completed by 2026-03-15
Milestone 2: Baseline perf targets and measurement dashboards by 2026-04-01
Milestone 3: Canary schedule + playbook for first model rotation by 2026-04-20
Milestone 4: Cost & quantization recommendation pilot rolled out to Dedicated by 2026-05-05
Milestone 5: GA release notes and customer comms by 2026-05-12
metrics_and_targets: Unit token cost target: reduce 1k-token cost by 12% vs baseline via batching and KV cache
Availability SLA target: 99.95% for hosted endpoints during business hours
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Model swap introduces regression in assistant flows - Mitigation: gated eval set + automatic rollback
Risk: Canary saturates autoscaler - Mitigation: pre-reserve burst capacity and rate-limit topologies
Risk: Customer confusion on lineup changes - Mitigation: phased deprecation notices and opt-in grace period
updates: 2026-03-02 - Initial scenario matrix drafted; reviewed with runtime and infra teams; needs perf targets from ENG.
2026-03-04 - DECISION: Use two-tier canary (internal traffic -> partner beta -> public) for all model rotations. Action: ENG to deliver canary hooks (ENG-24812).
2026-03-06 - Design provided draft communication templates and deprecation timeline; waiting on legal review for regulated-customer wording.
2026-03-06 - Added cost pilot to Milestone 4 after Optimize team recommendation; PM to coordinate pilot measurement plan.
actions_next: Assign ENG owners for staging perf runs by 2026-03-10
Finalize canary checklist and automation flags by 2026-03-18
Publish scenario dashboards and link to Console tracing by 2026-04-01
notes: Tradeoff: prioritizing latency-sensitive assistant flows may increase unit cost; recommend running a 2-week cost pilot on non-critical models.
Follow-up: Confirm legal language for EU customers under Private deployments; if required, add separate comms cadence.
